name: singlet_cell_state_cell_cycle_phase_assignment
title: Assign cell-cycle phase (G1, S, G2M)
description: Assigns each cell a discrete cell-cycle phase (G1, S, G2M, or Undecided) from its own transcriptome and writes the scores that produced the label. Use the default score_genes method on log-normalised data; cyclone_pairs needs raw counts and a pair table. Do not use it for continuous cycle position or to regress the cycle effect out of expression; those are separate tasks.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Phase rule. score_genes is the default. seurat_score applies Seurat's tie rule. cyclone_pairs needs raw counts and a pair table.

organism.description: Selects the built-in gene panel. Mouse symbols are mapped by capitalisation, an approximation of orthology.

gene_sets.description: Built-in Tirosh S and G2M lists (tirosh), or a uns key holding custom S and G2M gene lists.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for control-gene sampling and cyclone permutations. Fix it for reproducible labels.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing cc_phase, score and cyclone members instead of failing.

score_genes.description: Options for method score_genes (scanpy rule). Ignored by other methods.

ctrl_size.description: Control genes per expression bin. Null uses the smaller of the two list lengths.

n_bins.description: Number of expression bins for control-gene matching.

ctrl_as_ref.description: Draw controls from the full gene pool (ScanpyV1 preset); false follows ScanpyV2Preview.

seurat_score.description: Options for method seurat_score (Seurat tie rule).

n_bins.description: Expression bins for control matching, as in Seurat AddModuleScore.

ctrl_size.description: Control genes per bin. Null uses the smaller of the two list lengths.

cyclone_pairs.description: Options for method cyclone_pairs (permutation-null pair classifier).

pairs.description: Uns key holding phase pair tables for G1, S and G2M. Required for this method.

iter.description: Permutation shuffles per cell and phase.

min_iter.description: Minimum valid shuffles needed for a cell score.

min_pairs.description: Minimum informative pairs per phase; below this the score is missing.

s_threshold.description: Both G1 and G2M scores below this value give phase S.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/cc_phase. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, organism, n_cells, phase_counts (G1, S, G2M, Undecided) and undecided_fraction. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
